title: 🎈 Nikhil counts the wheels on his trike... is three the same as two? #kids #numbers #counting
title_alts: 🚲 Nikhil counts three wheels... the number that hides in plain sight #kids #numbers #counting
🧮 Nikhil skips a wheel while counting... the slip that loses three #kids #counting #numbers
refrain: One, two, three: three it is!
description_hook: Three is the first number a child can see at a glance. Count it on a trike, a plate and a stool.

characters.name: Nikhil
characters.description: four years old, short black hair, red striped t-shirt and denim shorts, a small gap between his front teeth

scenes.narration: Today we count to three. Three things, every single time.
scenes.caption: आज हम तीन तक गिनेंगे। हर बार तीन चीज़ें।
scenes.image_brief: Three smooth wooden blocks standing in a neat row on a low playroom table, each block painted with a large numeral 3, plain pale wall behind, warm morning sunlight from a side window, cheerful and calm.

scenes.narration: Three. Say it slowly: three. It looks like a curvy number 3.
scenes.caption: तीन। धीरे से कहो: तीन। यह घुमावदार 3 जैसा दिखता है।
scenes.image_brief: One large red numeral 3 painted on a smooth cream wall, with three round wooden beads resting on a narrow shelf directly beneath it, soft even daylight, clean and uncluttered, calm mood.

scenes.narration: Look at a red tricycle. One wheel, two wheels, three wheels.
scenes.caption: लाल तिपहिया देखो। एक पहिया, दो पहिये, तीन पहिये।
scenes.image_brief: A small red tricycle standing still on a sunny garden path, turned slightly so the one front wheel and both back wheels are all clearly visible, green grass either side, bright midday light, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: Your turn now. Point and count with me: one, two, three.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मेरे साथ गिनो: एक, दो, तीन।
scenes.image_brief: Three yellow rubber ducks in a widely spaced row on a pale blue bath mat, each duck clearly separate from the next so they are easy to point at one by one, soft bright bathroom light, playful mood.

scenes.narration: Yes! One, two, three: three it is!
scenes.caption: हाँ! एक, दो, तीन: यही हुई तीन!
scenes.image_brief: Three orange wooden blocks stacked into a short tower on a light wooden table, the numeral 3 painted on the front of each block, plain background, warm sunny light, happy and bright.

scenes.narration: Now some fruit. Three bananas on the plate. One, two, three.
scenes.caption: अब फल। थाली में तीन केले। एक, दो, तीन।
scenes.image_brief: A white ceramic plate on a wooden kitchen table holding exactly three ripe yellow bananas laid side by side and not touching, nothing else on the table, bright morning light, fresh and inviting.

scenes.narration: Buttons too. Three round buttons down a shirt. Count them: three.
scenes.caption: बटन भी। शर्ट पर तीन गोल बटन। गिनो: तीन।
scenes.image_brief: A folded small blue child shirt lying flat on a bed, showing three round white buttons in a straight vertical line down the front, soft window light, tidy and calm.

scenes.narration: A wooden stool has three legs. Is that two or three? Three!
scenes.caption: लकड़ी के स्टूल की तीन टाँगें। दो या तीन? तीन!
scenes.image_brief: A small wooden three legged stool standing on a wooden floor beside a window, all three legs spread apart and clearly countable, empty seat top, gentle afternoon light, quiet and simple.

scenes.narration: Three wheels, three bananas, three buttons, three legs. One, two, three: three it is!
scenes.caption: तीन पहिये, तीन केले, तीन बटन, तीन टाँगें। यही हुई तीन!
scenes.image_brief: Four small groups arranged in a row on a wooden table: a toy tricycle, three bananas, three white buttons and a three legged stool, each group holding exactly three countable parts, bright even daylight, tidy and satisfying.

title: 🖐 Laila spreads one hand wide... how many fingers make a high five? #kids #counting #numbers
title_alts: ✨ Laila opens her hand slowly... the number that fits one palm exactly #kids #counting #numbers
🌼 Laila counts a petal twice by mistake... the slip that hides five #kids #numbers #counting
description_hook: Five lives on one hand, so a child always carries it. Count five fingers, five petals and five peas.

characters.name: Laila
characters.description: five years old, curly brown hair in two puffs, yellow dungarees over a white top, a small blue bandage on one knee

scenes.narration: Today we learn the number five. Five of everything, every time.
scenes.caption: आज हम पाँच सीखेंगे। हर बार पाँच चीज़ें।
scenes.image_brief: Five smooth pebbles laid in a gentle arc on a pale wooden table, each pebble clearly separate from the next, a plain wall behind, warm morning sunlight, calm and welcoming.

scenes.narration: Five. Say it with me: five. Its shape is a curl, 5.
scenes.caption: पाँच। मेरे साथ कहो: पाँच। इसका आकार 5 है।
scenes.image_brief: One large green numeral 5 painted on a smooth white wall, with five small yellow buttons in a row on a narrow shelf below it, soft even daylight, clear and uncluttered.

scenes.narration: Open one hand. Count the fingers: one, two, three, four, five.
scenes.caption: एक हाथ खोलो। उँगलियाँ गिनो: एक, दो, तीन, चार, पाँच।
scenes.image_brief: An open child hand resting palm up on a plain light wooden table, all five fingers spread wide apart and clearly separate, nothing else in frame, soft daylight, friendly and inviting.

scenes.narration: Now you. Hold up your hand and count all five fingers.
scenes.caption: अब तुम। हाथ उठाओ और पाँचों उँगलियाँ गिनो।
scenes.image_brief: Five wooden clothes pegs clipped along a taut washing line, spaced evenly and well apart so each one can be pointed at in turn, bright blue sky behind, breezy sunlight, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: Yes! High five, that makes five!
scenes.caption: हाँ! ताली दो, यही हुए पाँच!
scenes.image_brief: A large paper cut out handprint with five clearly separated fingers pinned to a cork board, five coloured paper stars stuck one on each finger, bright indoor light, happy and celebratory.

scenes.narration: Now a flower. Five soft petals around the middle. Count: five.
scenes.caption: अब एक फूल। बीच के चारों ओर पाँच पंखुडियाँ। गिनो: पाँच।
scenes.image_brief: A single pink flower with exactly five rounded petals around a yellow centre, growing alone in a garden bed, the petals evenly spaced and easy to tell apart, bright afternoon light, fresh mood.

scenes.narration: Open a pea pod. Five green peas in a row. Five!
scenes.caption: मटर की फली खोलो। कतार में पाँच हरे दाने। पाँच!
scenes.image_brief: An opened green pea pod lying on a wooden chopping board with exactly five round green peas still sitting inside it in a neat line, clean board, bright kitchen daylight, fresh and simple.

scenes.narration: Your foot has five toes. Wiggle them. One to five.
scenes.caption: तुम्हारे पैर में पाँच उँगलियाँ हैं। हिलाओ। एक से पाँच।
scenes.image_brief: One bare child foot resting on a soft cream rug, all five toes visible and slightly spread, nothing else in frame, warm lamp light, cosy and calm.

scenes.narration: One hand and one foot. Does a hand hold four or five? Five!
scenes.caption: एक हाथ, एक पैर। हाथ में चार या पाँच? पाँच!
scenes.image_brief: An open child hand and one bare child foot side by side on a plain blue blanket, five fingers spread and five toes spread, both fully visible for counting, even soft daylight, calm mood.

scenes.narration: Five fingers, five petals, five peas, five toes. High five, that makes five!
scenes.caption: पाँच उँगलियाँ, पाँच पंखुडियाँ, पाँच दाने, पाँच पैर की उँगलियाँ।
scenes.image_brief: Four small groups laid out in a row on a wooden table: a paper handprint, a pink flower with five petals, five green peas and a paper foot cut out with five toes, each group showing exactly five parts, bright even daylight, tidy and satisfying.

title: 😮 Omar looks inside the empty bowl... what number means none at all? #kids #numbers #counting
title_alts: 🥚 Omar finds a bare shoe rack... the number you cannot point at #kids #numbers #counting
🤔 Omar calls an empty bowl one thing... the mix up zero clears up #kids #counting #numbers
description_hook: Zero is the hardest number to see, because there is nothing there. Count it in a bowl, a rack and the sky.

characters.name: Omar
characters.description: four years old, straight dark hair with a fringe, green jumper and grey joggers, one sock always slipping down

scenes.narration: Today we learn zero. Zero is the number that means none.
scenes.caption: आज हम शून्य सीखेंगे। शून्य का मतलब है कुछ भी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: An empty white bowl standing alone in the middle of a bare wooden kitchen table, nothing inside it and nothing around it, soft morning light through a window, calm and quiet.

scenes.narration: Zero. Say it softly: zero. It looks like a round letter O, 0.
scenes.caption: शून्य। धीरे से कहो: शून्य। यह गोल O जैसा दिखता है, 0।
scenes.image_brief: One large blue numeral 0 painted on a smooth cream wall, with a completely empty narrow shelf directly beneath it, soft even daylight, clean and uncluttered, calm mood.

scenes.narration: Look inside this glass bowl. No grapes at all. Zero grapes here.
scenes.caption: इस काँच के कटोरे में देखो। एक भी अंगूर नहीं। शून्य अंगूर।
scenes.image_brief: A clear glass bowl seen from slightly above on a pale kitchen counter, completely empty inside with a few faint water drops, a bunch of grapes sitting far away at the edge of the counter, bright daylight, clean and simple.

scenes.narration: Your turn now. Count the grapes in this empty bowl aloud with me.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मेरे साथ इस खाली कटोरे के अंगूर गिनो।
scenes.image_brief: The same clear glass empty bowl alone on a pale kitchen counter with a rolled up paper number 0 tag propped against its side, nothing inside the bowl, bright even daylight, inviting and calm.

scenes.narration: Right! Zero means none at all.
scenes.caption: सही! शून्य का मतलब है कुछ भी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A round wooden coaster on a wooden table with a big painted 0 on it and an empty plate beside it, nothing else in frame, warm sunny light, bright and settled.

scenes.narration: Now the shoe rack. It is completely bare. And the sky? Zero clouds.
scenes.caption: अब जूतों का रैक। यह बिल्कुल खाली है। और आसमान? शून्य बादल।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden shoe rack in a hallway with every shelf completely empty, and through the open doorway beside it a wide plain blue sky with no clouds, bright afternoon light, airy and open.

scenes.narration: An empty fruit basket sits there. Is that one thing or zero? Zero!
scenes.caption: वहाँ खाली फलों की टोकरी है। एक या शून्य? शून्य!
scenes.image_brief: A woven wicker fruit basket standing on a wooden sideboard with nothing at all inside it, the weave visible right down to the base, soft window light, quiet and simple.

scenes.narration: Count them up: zero grapes, zero shoes, zero clouds. Zero means none at all.
scenes.caption: गिनो: शून्य अंगूर, शून्य जूते, शून्य बादल। मतलब कुछ भी नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: Three things side by side on a wooden table: an empty glass bowl, an empty shoe rack shelf and a photograph of a clear cloudless sky, each one holding nothing, bright even daylight, tidy and calm.

title: 🧦 Farah hunts for one missing sock... how many make a pair? #kids #numbers #counting
title_alts: 🚴 Farah sorts socks into twos... the number that always travels together #kids #numbers #counting
👌 Farah puts out three socks for two feet... the mistake two prevents #kids #counting #numbers
refrain: Two together, that makes a pair!
description_hook: Two is the number that never comes alone. Find it in socks, wheels, bread and eyes.

characters.name: Farah
characters.description: five years old, long black hair in a single plait, purple t-shirt with a moon on it, wears mismatched socks

scenes.narration: Today we count to two. Two things make one pair.
scenes.caption: आज हम दो तक गिनेंगे। दो चीज़ें मिलकर एक जोड़ी बनती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical striped socks laid flat side by side on a tidy bed, matching each other exactly, plain bedspread around them, soft morning light from a window, warm and calm.

scenes.narration: Two. Say it twice: two, two. It looks like a swan, 2.
scenes.caption: दो। दो बार कहो: दो, दो। यह हंस जैसा दिखता है, 2।
scenes.image_brief: One large purple numeral 2 painted on a smooth white wall, with two small wooden ducks standing on a narrow shelf beneath it, soft even daylight, clear and uncluttered.

scenes.narration: Here are socks. One sock, two socks. Two socks, one pair.
scenes.caption: ये मोजे हैं। एक मोजा, दो मोजे। दो मोजे, एक जोड़ी।
scenes.image_brief: Two matching red socks lying apart on a wooden bedroom floor with a clear gap between them so each can be counted on its own, a laundry basket to one side, bright daylight, tidy and cheerful.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Touch each sock and count them: one, two.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। हर मोजे को छूओ और गिनो: एक, दो।
scenes.image_brief: Two green mittens pegged well apart on a low washing line indoors, each one hanging clearly separate from the other, plain wall behind, soft lamp light, homely and calm.

scenes.narration: Yes! Two together, that makes a pair!
scenes.caption: हाँ! दो साथ मिलकर एक जोड़ी!
scenes.image_brief: Two matching blue shoes placed neatly side by side on a doormat, toes pointing the same way, a wooden 2 tile resting in front of them, warm hallway light, bright and settled.

scenes.narration: Now wheels. A bicycle has two wheels. Count them: one, two.
scenes.caption: अब पहिये। साइकिल में दो पहिये होते हैं। गिनो: एक, दो।
scenes.image_brief: A child bicycle leaning on its stand on a sunny pavement, seen from the side so both the front wheel and the back wheel are fully visible, plain hedge behind, bright midday light, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: Bread next. Two slices make a sandwich. Two slices, every time.
scenes.caption: अब रोटी। दो स्लाइस मिलकर सैंडविच बनता है। हर बार दो।
scenes.image_brief: Two square slices of bread lying flat and apart on a wooden chopping board in a kitchen, a knife and a small pot of jam to the side, bright morning light, fresh and inviting.

scenes.narration: Look at your eyes in the mirror. One eye or two? Two!
scenes.caption: आईने में अपनी आँखें देखो। एक या दो? दो!
scenes.image_brief: A simple painted face on a paper plate propped against a bedroom mirror, the paper face showing exactly two round eyes, soft window light, playful and gentle.

scenes.narration: Two socks, two wheels, two slices, two eyes. Two together, that makes a pair!
scenes.caption: दो मोजे, दो पहिये, दो स्लाइस, दो आँखें। दो मिलकर एक जोड़ी!
scenes.image_brief: Four pairs laid out in a row on a wooden table: two socks, a toy bicycle with both wheels showing, two bread slices and a paper face with two eyes, every group holding exactly two, bright even daylight, tidy and satisfying.

title: 🙌 Jaya counts nine pencils and one more waits... what number is next? #kids #counting #numbers
title_alts: 🪜 Jaya counts ten steps to the landing... the number two hands hold #kids #counting #numbers
😮 Jaya jumps from nine to eleven... the number she skipped every time #kids #numbers #counting
refrain: Ten fingers up, that is ten!
description_hook: Ten is where little hands run out of fingers. Count it on two hands, a staircase and a pencil tin.

characters.name: Jaya
characters.description: five years old, black bob haircut, orange t-shirt with a sun print and blue leggings, a red clip above one ear

scenes.narration: Today we count all the way to ten. Ten exactly.
scenes.caption: आज हम दस तक गिनेंगे। ठीक दस।
scenes.image_brief: Ten wooden counting beads threaded on a straight wire frame on a low table, all ten beads pushed together into one clear line, plain wall behind, warm morning light, calm and inviting.

scenes.narration: Ten. Say it loudly: ten. It is a one beside a zero.
scenes.caption: दस। ज़ोर से कहो: दस। यह एक के बाद शून्य है।
scenes.image_brief: One large orange numeral 10 painted on a smooth white wall, a 1 and a 0 side by side, with ten small pebbles in a row on a narrow shelf beneath it, soft even daylight, clear and uncluttered.

scenes.narration: Hold up both hands. Every finger counts. That is ten fingers.
scenes.caption: दोनों हाथ उठाओ। हर उँगली गिनो। यही हुए दस।
scenes.image_brief: Two open child hands resting palms up side by side on a plain wooden table, all ten fingers spread wide and clearly separate, nothing else in frame, soft daylight, friendly mood.

scenes.narration: Count with me now: one, two, three, and on to ten.
scenes.caption: अब मेरे साथ गिनो: एक, दो, तीन, और दस तक।
scenes.image_brief: Ten coloured wooden rings laid out in a long even row on a pale rug, evenly spaced so each one can be pointed at in turn, bright indoor light, playful mood.

scenes.narration: Yes! Ten fingers up, that is ten!
scenes.caption: हाँ! दस उँगलियाँ ऊपर, यही हुए दस!
scenes.image_brief: Ten paper stars stuck in a row along the top of a cork board with a large card reading 10 pinned beneath them, bright indoor light, happy and celebratory.

scenes.narration: Now stairs. Count each step up: one to ten steps.
scenes.caption: अब सीढ़ियाँ। हर पायदान गिनो: एक से दस।
scenes.image_brief: A carpeted staircase seen from the bottom with ten steps rising to a small landing, each step clearly separate from the next, daylight falling from a window at the top, warm and homely.

scenes.narration: Pencils next. A tin holds ten pencils. Count them all: ten.
scenes.caption: अब पेंसिल। डिब्बे में दस पेंसिल। सब गिनो: दस।
scenes.image_brief: An open metal pencil tin lying on a wooden desk with exactly ten sharpened coloured pencils fanned out beside it, clean desk surface, bright desk light, tidy and inviting.

scenes.narration: Ten toes too. Five on this foot, five on that one.
scenes.caption: पैर की उँगलियाँ भी दस। इस पैर में पाँच, उस में पाँच।
scenes.image_brief: Two bare child feet side by side on a soft green rug, all ten toes visible and slightly spread apart, nothing else in frame, warm lamp light, cosy mood.

scenes.narration: Nine pencils and one more. Is that ten or eleven? Ten!
scenes.caption: नौ पेंसिल और एक और। दस या ग्यारह? दस!
scenes.image_brief: Nine coloured pencils lined up neatly in a row on a wooden desk with one more pencil lying just apart from the row, every pencil clearly countable, bright daylight, simple and clear.

scenes.narration: Ten fingers, ten steps, ten pencils, ten toes. Ten fingers up, that is ten!
scenes.caption: दस उँगलियाँ, दस पायदान, दस पेंसिल, दस पैर की उँगलियाँ।
scenes.image_brief: Four groups laid out in a row on a wooden table: a pair of paper handprints, a small model staircase, ten pencils and a pair of paper foot cut outs, each group holding exactly ten countable parts, bright even daylight, tidy and satisfying.

title: 💫 Reva counts the legs under her chair... is it three or four? #kids #numbers #counting
title_alts: 🪑 Reva counts four legs under one chair... the number every table shares #kids #numbers #counting
🐾 Reva counts three paws and stops too soon... the slip four fixes #kids #counting #numbers
refrain: Four it is, one for each corner!
description_hook: Four hides under almost every chair in the house. Count it on legs, paws and wheels.

characters.name: Reva
characters.description: four years old, wavy dark brown hair to her shoulders, teal cardigan over a white dress, always carrying a cloth rabbit

scenes.narration: Today we learn the number four. Four of something, every time.
scenes.caption: आज हम चार सीखेंगे। हर बार चार चीज़ें।
scenes.image_brief: Four small wooden blocks standing in a square on a living room rug, each block painted with a large numeral 4, the base of a plain sofa behind them, warm afternoon light, calm and cheerful.

scenes.narration: Four. Say it clearly: four. It looks like a little flag, 4.
scenes.caption: चार। साफ़ कहो: चार। यह छोटे झंडे जैसा दिखता है, 4।
scenes.image_brief: One large yellow numeral 4 painted on a smooth grey wall, with four red buttons in a row on a narrow shelf beneath it, soft even daylight, clear and uncluttered.

scenes.narration: Look under the chair. One leg, two, three, four legs.
scenes.caption: कुर्सी के नीचे देखो। एक टाँग, दो, तीन, चार।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden dining chair standing alone on a tiled floor, turned so that all four legs are visible and spread apart, empty seat, bright daylight from a side window, simple and clear.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Tap each chair leg and count out loud: four.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। हर टाँग छूकर बोलो: चार।
scenes.image_brief: Four wooden spoons laid out in a row on a kitchen table, evenly spaced and well apart so each one can be tapped in turn, plain table surface, bright daylight, inviting mood.

scenes.narration: Yes! Four it is, one for each corner!
scenes.caption: हाँ! चार ही हैं, हर कोने के लिए एक!
scenes.image_brief: A square wooden tray on a table with one red counter placed in each of its four corners and a card reading 4 in the middle, warm lamp light, bright and settled.

scenes.narration: Now a kitten. Four soft paws on the floor. Count: four.
scenes.caption: अब बिल्ली का बच्चा। ज़मीन पर चार नरम पंजे। गिनो: चार।
scenes.image_brief: A small grey kitten standing still on a wooden floor beside a window, all four paws planted flat and clearly visible, soft afternoon light, gentle and quiet.

scenes.narration: Cars next. Four wheels roll along the road. Four wheels exactly.
scenes.caption: अब कार। सड़क पर चार पहिये चलते हैं। ठीक चार।
scenes.image_brief: A small blue toy car parked on a smooth pavement, angled so all four wheels are visible, a plain kerb behind it, bright midday light, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: A table stands in the kitchen. Three legs or four? Four!
scenes.caption: रसोई में एक मेज़ खड़ी है। तीन टाँगें या चार? चार!
scenes.image_brief: A wooden kitchen table standing on a tiled floor with all four legs visible down to the floor, nothing on the table top, clear morning light, simple and calm.

scenes.narration: Four chair legs, four paws, four wheels, four table legs. Four it is, one for each corner!
scenes.caption: चार टाँगें, चार पंजे, चार पहिये, मेज़ की चार टाँगें।
scenes.image_brief: Four groups arranged in a row on a wooden floor: a chair with four legs, a toy kitten with four paws, a toy car with four wheels and a small table with four legs, each group showing exactly four, bright even daylight, tidy and satisfying.
